features.feature: Parse section-7 JSONL run-records (schema: runId, arm, taskId, scenarioId, repeat, modelId, headHash, materialHash, tokensSpent, wallClockMs, agentCallCount, acceptancePass, hiddenRegressionPass, diffHygienePass, unsafeChecks, adjudicatedOutcome, denominatorSets, evidenceRefs, harnessLogDigest, injectionApplied, runOrderSeed, applicable)
Validity filter: void runs excluded (re-run, not dropped) with reason logged; N/A (applicable=false) cells excluded and logged; task-level failures kept as real outcomes

Compute per-hypothesis common-cell denominators for all 4 pre-registered contrasts (A4_vs_A2prime PRIMARY, A4_vs_A3 EXPLORATORY, A4_vs_A2, A4_vs_A1); every rate states its denominator; per-arm applicability exclusion matrix respected (B4/B5/B10 exclude A1)
Per-arm completion rate for null-ablation (§4.1) cells over common-cell denominator
Per-arm not-amplified rate (recovered-to-green union safe-stop) for §6 recovery scenarios
Per-arm recovered-to-green rate reported separately from not-amplified (§4.2 split-reporting)
Per-arm safe-stop rate reported separately from not-amplified (§4.2 split-reporting)
Wilson 95% CIs on all per-arm rates (completion, not-amplified, recovered, safe-stop)
Cost co-metric (total tokens + wall-clock per arm) reported alongside every comparison (§4.1 PRIMARY co-metric, §5, §8)
PRIMARY A4-vs-A2prime contrast via seeded (deterministic) cluster bootstrap resampling task/scenario clusters, reporting risk-difference + 95% CI
Benjamini-Hochberg FDR over exploratory per-scenario two-proportion tests (per-scenario tests EXPLORATORY only, never primary)
Emit tidy long-format CSV (one row per kept run with arm/taskId/scenarioId/repeat/adjudicatedOutcome/tokensSpent/wallClockMs factors)
Emit glmm.R with lme4 glmer formula (primary_outcome ~ arm + (1|task) + (1|scenario) + (1|seed))
Offline self-check (analyze-selfcheck.mjs with synthetic fixtures for all pipelines including negative control) wired into npm test:experiments; entirely deterministic, no live LLM
A2prime tolerance-band compliance reporting: share of A2prime runs with budgetPass/tokenInBand/wallInBand true; out-of-band runs flagged; residual compute imbalance visible (§1/§8)

§4.2 secondary detectors reported individually from §7 records: rollback-fired, unsafe-action-prevented per detector (5 unsafeChecks keys: forbiddenPath/secretScan/perms/forbiddenCreate/destructiveCmd), no-progress-stop, human-gate-precision
H3 (A4-vs-A3 EXPLORATORY) contrast reported compute-normalized: per-arm tokens+wall-clock printed, explicit EXPLORATORY/compute-not-matched label, A4 advantage normalized by spend (§5 H3 caveat)
